supporting_declaration: Deterministic affinity-level normalization, table/partition group IDs, and missing-partition validation are ported; TiKV key encoding, PD calls, catalog mutation, coordinator ordering, and cleanup remain open.
CREATE TABLE AFFINITY now runs the typed level validator before the existing pre-commit unsupported boundary; physical affinity publication remains open.
The three source unit-test boundaries cover table definitions, partition definitions/missing metadata, and stable group IDs; PD interaction and DDL lifecycle tests remain external.
